#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long a, long long b) {
    if (b == 0) return 1;
    long long half = modpow(a, b / 2);
    half = half * half % MOD;
    if (b & 1) half = half * a % MOD;
    return half;
}

struct Matrix {
    long long a, b, c, d;
    Matrix(long long a_, long long b_, long long c_, long long d_) : a(a_), b(b_), c(c_), d(d_) {}
    
    Matrix multiply(const Matrix& o) const {
        return Matrix(
            (a * o.a + b * o.c) % MOD,
            (a * o.b + b * o.d) % MOD,
            (c * o.a + d * o.c) % MOD,
            (c * o.b + d * o.d) % MOD
        );
    }
    
    Matrix pow(long long e) const {
        if (e == 0) return Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1);
        if (e == 1) return *this;
        Matrix half = pow(e / 2);
        Matrix square = half.multiply(half);
        if (e & 1) return square.multiply(*this);
        else return square;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    long long n, m, L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;
    
    if (n % 2 == 1 && m % 2 == 1) {
        cout << modpow((R - L + 1) % MOD, n * m) << "\n";
    } else {
        long long cnt = R - L + 1;
        if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
            long long allbutone = modpow(cnt % MOD, n * m - 1);
            cout << allbutone * (cnt / 2) % MOD << "\n";
        } else {
            long long k = cnt / 2;
            Matrix mat(k, k + 1, k + 1, k);
            Matrix res = mat.pow(n * m);
            cout << res.a << "\n";
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
